data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines classes; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on 2019 and prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2019 and prior years developed adversely to expectation, driven by an increase in the excess inflation allowance, strengthening on UK Liability business in response to COVID-related reporting delays, and a reduction in anticipated reinsurance recoveries.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was GBP 1,269.6m. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 39.8m (3.14% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse prior-year development in Financial Lines and Liability business and by inflation-related reserve strengthening, partially offset by favourable development in other classes. COVID-19 related reporting delays and reduced anticipated reinsurance recoveries were also cited as influences on prior-year movements.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines classes; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.
higher-than-expected attritional loss experience on Financial Lines and Liability classes.
prior accident year reserves have been strengthened for inflation loadings.
The 2019 and prior years developed adversely to expectation, producing a net underwriting loss of GBP 46m.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior-year column). Prior-year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note allocation: 'Claims expense - previous financial year' = 39.8 (gross). A claims development triangle is present in the report but the parsed text contained formatting ambiguities; the triangle was not fully and reliably reconstructed for per-year cell extraction, so triangle development rows are omitted here. Some narrative figures elsewhere are net of reinsurance; this extraction prefers gross figures per instructions.
